name: Dustwind Dig
summary: Dustwind Dig is an Alliance camp and archaeological staging ground nestled in the hills of the Badlands. Overseen by the dwarf Sigrun Ironhew, it serves as a secure foothold above the perilous lower excavations.

sections.title: A Foothold in the Wastes
sections.body: Perched on the high ridges overlooking Hammertoe's Digsite, Dustwind Dig provides dwarven prospectors and Alliance wanderers a defensible haven against the harsh elements and aggressive troggs of the Badlands. From here, Sigrun Ironhew attempts to coordinate field operations and maintain supply lines deep within the hostile desert.

sections.title: Excavation and Survival
sections.body: Archaeological work in the Badlands is dangerous business. Dustwind Dig stands as a vital observation point and waypoint, keeping an eye on dwarven expeditions below while holding out against the encroaching threats native to the dusty valleys.

faq.answer: Dustwind Dig is an Alliance expedition camp in the hills of the Badlands, functioning as a primary outpost for dwarven researchers and travelers traversing the arid wasteland.
The outpost is run by Sigrun Ironhew, who manages the local dig efforts and keeps the camp fortified against local hazards.

faq.q: Why is the camp situated in the hills?
faq.answer: Positioned directly above Hammertoe's Digsite, the high ground grants better defense and a clear vantage over the chaotic lower excavations infested with hostile troggs.

angles.text: For dwarves of Ironforge, Dustwind Dig represents the sheer stubbornness of the Explorers' League, refusing to abandon ancient secrets even in the most unforgiving corners of the Eastern Kingdoms.
Dustwind Dig is one of the few places in the hostile Badlands where Alliance members can safely rest, resupply, and coordinate their travels.
